content.title: Motion Traces | Floor Contact Builds a Persistent Group Color Field
content.summary: Establish a bounded floor and clearly adult performers before escalating from upright coordination to readable floor contact and rotation. Assign each performer a distinct persistent trace family, accumulate the paths monotonically, reveal the combined history from overhead, and return the complete ensemble to a standing terminal formation beside the unchanged field.

quick_start.input_format: bounded performance floor + clearly adult ensemble baseline + upright-to-floor-contact escalation + performer-specific trace families + monotonic path accumulation + overhead proof + complete standing formation
quick_start.recommended_input: Three clearly adult turbine-maintenance acrobats in charcoal, ivory, and rust coveralls perform inside a circular machine hall. A hand plant, knee pivot, and controlled shoulder rotation leave separate copper, chalk-white, and cobalt mineral trails. An overhead view proves three interlocking paths before the adults return to a stable standing triangle around the persistent field.
required_anchors: Establish one bounded floor and stable adult performer identities before marks appear.
Escalate from upright coordination to at least two readable floor-contact or rotation actions.
Accumulate marks monotonically and reveal the combined path history from above.
End with all performers back in a complete formation while the accumulated field remains.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Establish a bounded floor and clearly adult performers before escalating from upright coordination to readable floor contact and rotation. Assign each performer a distinct persistent trace family, accumulate the paths monotonically, reveal the combined history from overhead, and return the complete ensemble to a standing terminal formation beside the unchanged field.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish one bounded performance floor and two or more clearly adult performers with stable identities and spacing. Escalate choreography from upright coordination into readable floor contact and rotation. Bind one distinct visual mark family to each performer's actual contact or movement path; marks persist and accumulate instead of appearing before the motion. Use an overhead proof to reveal the combined path history, then return to a complete standing formation while the accumulated field remains visible. The reusable mechanism is motion-authored trace accumulation and terminal formation proof, not the source dancers, school-inspired clothing, city plaza, crowd, breakdance sequence, exact orange-pink-cyan palette, paint shapes, framing, creator identity or model branding.

invariants.rule: Establish one bounded floor and stable adult performer identities before marks appear.
invariants.purpose: Creates a spatial and identity baseline for later trail ownership.
invariants.ablation_failure: Starting inside a completed color field makes causality unreadable.

invariants.rule: Escalate from upright coordination to at least two readable floor-contact or rotation actions.
invariants.purpose: Gives mark generation distinct physical causes.
invariants.ablation_failure: Random cuts or airborne gestures cannot prove surface-authored traces.

invariants.rule: Assign one persistent visual mark family to each performer and bind it to actual paths.
invariants.ablation_failure: Shared undifferentiated splashes detach the result from individual motion.

invariants.rule: Accumulate marks monotonically and reveal the combined path history from above.
invariants.purpose: Turns choreography into a legible graphic record.
invariants.ablation_failure: Resetting marks between actions removes temporal evidence.

invariants.rule: End with all performers back in a complete formation while the accumulated field remains.
invariants.purpose: Preserves both agents and result for terminal proof.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending only on abstract paint replaces the performance instead of resolving it.

the source breakdance choreography, floorwork sequence, performer spacing and final standing poses

the source creator identity, model branding, watermark, grade and editing rhythm
